description: Estimation of Switching Surge Flashover Rate for a 1200 kV UHVAC Transmission Line by Considering Switching Overvoltage Wave shape is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Ramchandra Reddy (Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology). The insulation of the power transmission systems experience stresses due to overvoltages and hence the insulation design of Extra High Voltage and Ultra High Voltage systems depend on the switching overvoltages, not lightning overvoltages. Insulation failure probability under switching overvoltages is the main impressive concern in the estimation of switching surge flashover rate. . Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
